title: Executioner Mo Unmasked
summary: Nalan Yanran and Elder Ge Ye of the Misty Cloud Sect attend Mo Cheng's birthday banquet. Mo Cheng announces the Mo Alliance to unite the north-eastern Jia Ma Empire, and several forces join. A masked Xiao Yan with Yao Lao's power breaks in, uses Vacuum Hand, and demands Qing Lin, calling Yun Yun a blind old woman. Nalan Yanran defends her master and Mo Cheng's good name. Hai Bodong reveals a beast experiment from Mo's laboratory, and the Misty Cloud Sect withdraws its support. Mo Cheng turns himself into a half-human, half-beast monster, eats one of his own men, and flees with Qing Lin. He hides inside an Isolation Shield that even the Heavenly Flame cannot break.
events: Nalan Yanran and Elder Ge Ye arrive at the Mo Residence.
Mo Cheng announces the Mo Alliance; Tao Homestead, Black Water Ridge and Feilun Castle join.
Xiao Yan, masked and with Dou Huang power, demands Qing Lin and insults Yun Yun.
Nalan Yanran tries to stop him; Mo Cheng claims he is a man of justice.
Xiao Yan and Hai Bodong show a lab experiment; the Misty Cloud Sect leaves.
Mo Cheng becomes a half-beast monster and eats one of his men.
He grabs Qing Lin and hides in an Isolation Shield.
introduced: Isolation Shield (blocks attacks below Dou Zong and Heavenly Flames)
